headline: Oil prices jump more than 7% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
detail: Geopolitical tensions are driving oil prices significantly higher. This can create broader market uncertainty and a 'risk-off' sentiment, which typically puts pressure on growth-oriented tech and chip stocks like those in your portfolio, especially when trading on margin.
rec: No direct trade is warranted by this headline alone. However, it reinforces the need for caution and strict adherence to your existing stops on tech and chip holdings.
